blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Do multilingual language models learn a universal internal geometry for color, and is it perceptually grounded or primarily linguistic? We decompose color representations into two geometric axes: (P1) alignment to perceptual color space, and (P2) cross-lingual symmetry. Analyzing layerwise embeddings across models and multilingual datasets, we find that perceptual grounding is weak: alignment to CIE-LAB peaks in intermediate layers, then collapses toward output layers. Cross-lingual symmetry degrades with depth, suggesting later layers encode language-specific structure. Functionally, we show that geometric properties predict task performance: models achieve 96.7% accuracy on color classification at layers where P1 alignment peaks, with P1 alignment (r=0.70) significantly correlating with downstream capabilities. Our results reveal a dissociation: text-only LMs learn universal color-language geometry, not universal color-perception geometry, providing diagnostics for where perceptual structure is preserved in language models.
blocks.zh: 多语种语言模型是否学习了一种通用的内相几何来表示颜色,它是否在概念上立足还是以语言为主? 我们把颜色表示分解成两个几何轴: (P1)与知觉色彩空间相接, (P2) 交叉语言对称. 分析跨模型和多语言数据集的分层嵌入,我们发现感知地平线很弱:与中间层的CIE-LAB峰相接,然后倒向输出层. 跨语言对称以深度降解,建议后层编码语言特有结构. 在功能上,我们显示几何属性预测任务性能:模型在P1对齐峰值的地层实现色分级的96.7%的精度,而P1对齐(r=0.70)与下游能力有显著的关联. 我们的研究结果揭示了一种分化:只有文本的LM学习了通用色彩语言几何,而不是通用色彩感知几何,为语言模型中保存了知觉结构的地方提供了诊断.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Do Language Models (LMs) build latent geometric structures that systematically organize meaning? Recent work suggests neural representations are best viewed as geometric objects—manifolds or trajectories in activation space. In language models, latent factors trace continuous curves in hidden states ( Dohmatob et al., 2023 ; Engels et al., 2025 ) , while in vision, object manifolds become more compact across layers ( Ansuini et al., 2019 ; Cohen et al., 2020 ) . Competing hypotheses have emerged: the Linear Representation Hypothesis ( Park et al., 2024 ) posits that concepts correspond to linear directions, while the Platonic Representation Hypothesis ( Huh et al., 2024 ) argues that representations converge toward shared structure across architectures. Yet how these geometries align with real-world perceptual structure remains unclear.
blocks.zh: 语言模型(LM)是否构建潜在的几何结构,系统地组织意义? 最近的研究表明,神经表达最好被视为几何物体——激活空间中的迷幻物或轨迹。 在语言模型中,潜伏因素在隐藏状态中追踪连续曲线(Dohmatob等人,2023年;Engels等人,2025年),而在视觉中,物体多面体跨层变得更加紧凑(Ansuini等人,2019年;Cohen等人,2020年)。 相互竞争的假设已经出现:线性表示假说(Park等人,2024年)假设概念与线性方向相对应,而Platonic表示假说(Huh等人,2024年)则认为,表示式向跨架构共享结构趋同. 然而,这些地理特征如何与现实世界的观念结构相配合仍然不清楚。

blocks.en: We use color as a concrete testbed. It has well-studied perceptual geometry (CIE–LAB) as a proxy for human similarity, and multilingual datasets exposing systematic cross-linguistic variation ( Winawer et al., 2007 ; Gibson et al., 2017 ) . This makes it ideal for disentangling perceptual structure from linguistic categorization, and for testing whether LMs learn compact, perceptually grounded geometry shared across languages.
blocks.zh: 我们用颜色做混凝土测试床 其作为人类相似性的代名词的透视几何学(CIE-LAB)得到了很好的研究,多语种数据集暴露了系统性的跨语言变异(Winawer等人,2007年;Gibson等人,2017年). 这使得将观念结构从语言分类中分离出来,以及测试LMs是否学习紧凑的、概念上基于各种语言的几何学,成为理想。

blocks.en: We ask: What geometric structure do multilingual language models learn for color—one aligned with perceptual space (CIE–LAB), language-driven categorical geometry, or a mix that shifts across layers? This question exposes two geometric axes: (P1) perceptual alignment—does similarity geometry match CIE–LAB, and at which layers? (P2) cross-lingual symmetry—is geometry shared across languages or does it drift with linguistic variation?
blocks.zh: 我们问:多语种语言模型学习什么几何结构的颜色——一种与感知空间(CIE-LAB)一致,一种语言驱动的绝对几何结构,或者一种跨层变化的组合? 这个问题暴露了两个几何轴:(P1) 知觉对齐——相似度几何匹配CIE-LAB, 以及哪个层? (P2)跨语言对称性——是跨语言共享的几何,还是随语言变异而漂移?

blocks.en: Our approach is pragmatic: we do not expect text-only LMs to reproduce human perception. Instead, we use LAB as a template to measure to what extent color structure is preserved or altered at each layer. We analyze layerwise representations across models and multilingual datasets, assessing kernel alignment with CIE–LAB and measuring cross-lingual drift.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法是务实的:我们不期望只用文本的LMs会复制人类的观念。 相反,我们使用LAB作为模板,衡量每一层的颜色结构保存或改变的程度。 我们分析跨模型和多语言数据集的分层表述,评估内核与CIE-LAB的吻合,并测量跨语言漂移。

blocks.en: We find a clear dissociation: text-only LMs learn a compact color-language geometry that is partly universal 1 1 1 Throughout, “universal” refers to trends consistent across diverse text-only causal LMs. Multimodal or vision-conditioned models can deviate due to different training objectives, which we treat as informative evidence about how training signals shape representational geometry. across languages, yet perceptual (LAB) alignment is weak and, when present, peaks in intermediate layers before collapsing at output. Cross-lingual congruence is highest in early layers and degrades with depth. Functionally, these geometric properties predict downstream task performance, with models achieving 96.7% accuracy on color classification at layers where alignment peaks.
blocks.zh: 我们发现一种明显的脱离:只有文本的LMs学会了一种紧凑的色彩语言几何学,部分是通用的 11 1 通篇说,“通用”是指不同文本中一致的只有文本的因果关系LMs的趋势。 由于培训目标不同,多种模式或视线模式可能有所偏离,我们把培训信号如何形成代表几何的丰富证据视为不同培训目标。 不同语言之间,然而知觉(LAB)的对齐性很弱,在出现时,在输出时崩溃前会达到中间层的峰值. 跨语言的一致度在早期层中最高,并随着深度而降解. 在功能上,这些几何属性预测下游任务性能,模型在对齐峰值的层次上对颜色分类达到96.7%的精度.

blocks.en: We introduce internal color geometry as a testbed for analyzing how multilingual LMs organize perceptual-like domains, develop a layerwise framework combining perceptual kernel alignment and cross-lingual symmetry analysis, and provide evidence that LMs learn stable color-language geometry without strong perceptual grounding. This reveals that universality can emerge without perceptual alignment, with functional implications for layer selection in downstream applications.
blocks.zh: 我们引入内色几何作为分析多语种LM如何组织知觉类域的试验台,开发一个分层框架,结合知觉内核对齐和跨语言对称性分析,并提供证据表明LM学习稳定的色语几何,而没有强烈的知觉定位. 这表明,普遍性可能在不进行概念调整的情况下出现,对下游应用中的层层选择有功能影响。

blocks.en: 1.1 Problem Formulation: Internal Color Geometry
blocks.zh: 1.1 问题表述:内部颜色几何

blocks.en: We analyze the geometry of color meaning in multilingual LMs. Given colors with multilingual descriptions, we ask what geometric patterns the model expresses and how they relate to perceptual color space (CIE–LAB) and cross-lingual invariance. We use perceptual color spaces as reference geometries—not because text-only models should match human vision, but to measure what geometry language supervision produces and where it aligns with perception.
blocks.zh: 我们分析多语种LMs中的颜色含义几何. 由于颜色带有多种语言的描述,我们询问模型表达的几何图案,以及它们与知觉色空间(CIE-LAB)和跨语言的偏差的关系。 我们使用知觉色彩空间作为参考——不是因为只使用文字的模型应该符合人类的视觉,而是用来测量几何语言监督产生什么,以及它与知觉一致的地方.

blocks.en: We focus on two geometric properties of layerwise representations. First, (P1) perceptual alignment : does the model’s similarity geometry match perceptual space, and at which layers? We test whether neighborhoods or kernels from the model distance matrix match those from CIE–LAB, up to global distortions. Second, (P2) cross-lingual symmetry : given colors described in multiple languages, is geometry stable or does linguistic form distort pairwise structure? We quantify this by comparing language-specific kernels on matched samples.
blocks.zh: 我们侧重于分层表示的两个几何特性。 首先,(P1) 感知对齐 : 模型的相似度几何匹配感知空间吗, 在哪个层? 我们测试来自模型距离矩阵的邻里或内核是否与来自CIE-LAB的相匹配,直到全球扭曲。 第二,(P2) 跨语言对称性 : 给定多种语言描述的颜色,几何稳定还是语言形式扭曲双向结构? 我们通过在匹配的样本上比较特定语言的内核来量化这一点.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Representations in deep networks often lie on low-dimensional manifolds ( Ansuini et al., 2019 ; Cohen et al., 2020 ; Modell et al., 2025 ) , compared via RSA ( Kriegeskorte et al., 2008 ) , CKA ( Kornblith et al., 2019 ) , and kernel methods ( Gretton et al., 2005 ) . We extend this toolkit to a concrete grounded domain, i.e., color, where ground-truth perceptual structure (CIE–LAB) exists, enabling direct tests of whether learned geometry reflects perception or language-specific categorization. Crucially, we show that low dimensionality need not imply perceptual grounding.
blocks.zh: 深层网络中的表述往往停留在低维多维上(Ansuini等人,2019年;Cohen等人,2020年;Model等人,2025年),通过RSA进行比较。 (Kriegeskorte等人,2008年),CKA (Kornblith等人,2019年),以及内核方法(Gretton等人,2005年). 我们把这个工具箱扩展到一个具体的基础领域,即颜色,即存在地面真知灼见结构(CIE-LAB)的领域,从而能够直接测试所学几何学是否反映知觉或具体语言的分类。 关键的是,我们表明,低维度不一定意味着有概念的立足点。

blocks.en:
The Platonic Representation Hypothesis ( Huh et al., 2024 ) posits convergence to shared representations across models and modalities, while work on multilingual models shows cross-lingual similarity strongest in early layers, diverging with depth ( Conneau et al., 2017 ; Libovickỳ et al., 2020 ; Chi et al., 2020 ) .
Layerwise analyses also show that intermediate layers often carry more useful representations than the final one ( Skean et al., 2025 ) , consistent with the perceptual window we find for color.
We provide the first systematic analysis decomposing color geometry into perceptual alignment (P1) and cross-lingual symmetry (P2) , revealing that universality emerges without perceptual grounding. This challenges assumptions that universal representations imply perceptual grounding.
blocks.zh:
Platonic Presentation Hypothesis(Huh et al., 2024年)认为,不同模型和模式之间的共同表达是一致的,而多语种模型的工作显示,早期各层语言的相似性最强,深度不同(Conneau et al., 2017年;Libovickỳ et al., 2020年;Chi et al., 2020年)。
层层分析还表明,中间层往往比最终层(Skean等人,2025年)更有用,与我们发现的感知窗口颜色一致。
我们提供了第一次系统分析,将颜色几何分解成感官对齐(P1)和跨语言对称(P2),揭示出普遍性在没有感官定位的情况下出现. 这种质疑的假设是,普遍代表性意味着概念基础。

blocks.en:
Color naming has been central in linguistics ( Berlin and Kay, 1991 ; Regier et al., 2007 ) , and recent work examines LLM color-naming behavior through output accuracy ( Abdou et al., 2021 ; Loyola et al., 2023 ; Winn and Muresan, 2018 ) .
We focus instead on internal geometry across layers: testing whether color representations are compact, perceptually aligned, and language-invariant.
This geometric lens isolates where and why perceptual grounding fails in text-only models, revealing that perceptual structure is transiently expressed in intermediate layers but collapses toward output—a finding with direct implications for layer selection in applications.
blocks.zh:
彩色命名在语言学中一直占据中心地位(柏林和凯,1991年;雷吉耶等人,2007年),近期的作品通过输出精度来考察LLM色命名行为(Abdou等人,2021年;Loyola等人,2023年;Winn和Muresan,2018年).
相反,我们侧重于跨层的内部几何:测试颜色表示是否紧凑,概念上是否吻合,以及语言上是否存在差异。
这种几何透镜隔离了知觉定位在仅文本模型中失败之处和原因,揭示了知觉结构在中间层的瞬间表达,但向输出倾斜——这种发现对应用中的层选择有直接影响。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en:
This section specifies how we extract representations from language models,
define the induced geometry, and compute the two axes of analysis ( P1 – P2 )
together with uncertainty estimates. Our approach combines geometric analysis of internal representations with functional probing of task performance.
We directly analyze the geometric structure of representations to understand what
color-related knowledge is encoded and how it evolves across layers, then validate
whether geometric quality predicts downstream task utility.
This reveals both where (at which layers) and how (through what geometric properties)
models organize color meaning, and whether this organization matters functionally.

blocks.en:
To capture a more diverse range of figurative and semantically diverse color language, we build M-ColorNames from user-generated color names sourced from https://colornames.org/ .
Compared to MLMC , these descriptions include more nouns and associative phrases (e.g., olive oil , the swan ), and often omit basic color terms.
The original data does not include language labels, making language identification necessary but challenging: color names are short (a large fraction contains fewer than five tokens), borrow terms across languages, and can be ambiguous (e.g., “beige”). We use a two-stage language detection pipeline.
First, we apply GlotLID ( Kargaran et al., 2023 ) to obtain fast initial language estimates for the full corpus.
Second, we use GPT-4o ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) to refine these predictions, rebucketing examples where GlotLID’s output is uncertain or inconsistent.
The final dataset covers six languages, achieves 100% hue coverage, and spans L ∗ ∈ [ 0.4 , 99.7 ] L^{*}\!\in[0.4,\,99.7] , a ∗ ∈ [ − 85.5 , 96.6 ] a^{*}\!\in[-85.5,\,96.6] , b ∗ ∈ [ − 105.8 , 93.8 ] b^{*}\!\in[-105.8,\,93.8] .

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We organize results by the two geometric properties introduced in Section 1.1 : (P1) perceptual alignment and (P2) cross-lingual symmetry. For each, we report layer-wise profiles highlighting both peak performance and final-layer behavior (relevant for downstream applications). Then, we show that spectral structure (effective rank) predicts geometric quality across both axes, validate functional consequences via task probes, and present robustness controls.
blocks.zh: 我们用第1.1节引入的两个几何特性来组织结果:(P1) 知觉对齐和(P2) 跨语言对称。 对于每个系统,我们报告分层剖面,突出峰值性能和最终层行为(与下游应用相关)。 然后,我们显示光谱结构(有效排名)预测了两轴的几何质量,通过任务探测器验证功能后果,并提出强性控制.

blocks.en: Our findings reveal a clear dissociation in how multilingual language models organize color representations: they learn a geometry that is partly universal across languages, but not strongly perceptually grounded . Perceptual alignment to CIE–LAB and Cross-lingual congruence follow similar behavior: scores peak in early-to-intermediate layers, then collapse toward the output —precisely where next-token prediction occurs. However, their score ranges differ: 0.0–0.2 for P1 and 0.15–0.7 for P2 . Functionally, these geometric properties predict downstream task performance, with models achieving 96.7% accuracy on color classification at layers where alignment peaks.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究结果表明,在多语种语言模型如何组织彩色表达方式方面明显脱节:它们学会了几何学,这种几何学在语言中是部分通用的,但是没有强烈的观念基础。 与 CIE-LAB 和 Cross- people- commonce 的观念对齐遵循相似的行为:分数在早期到中间层达到峰值,然后倒向输出 — 确切地说就是发生下层预测的地方. 然而,它们的得分范围不同:P1为0.0-0.2,P2为0.15-0.7。 在功能上,这些几何属性预测下游任务性能,模型在对齐峰值的层次上对颜色分类达到96.7%的精度.

blocks.en: 5.1 Models and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 5.1 模式和评价议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate six pretrained causal language models spanning diverse architectures, training data, and scales: Gemma-2-2B and Gemma-2-9B ( Team, 2024a ) , Llama-3.1-8B ( Dubey et al., 2024 ) , Mistral-7B-v0.1 ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) , Qwen2.5-7B ( Team, 2024b ) , and the vision-language model PaliGemma2-3B ( Beyer et al., 2024 ) . All models are text-only causal transformers except PaliGemma2, which we include to test whether visual grounding alters color geometry. Models range from 26 to 42 layers with hidden dimensions between 2 048 and 3 584.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了6个经过预先训练的因果语言模型,这些模型涉及不同的架构、培训数据和尺度:Gemma-2-2B和Gemma-2-9B(Team,2024a),Llama-3.1-8B。 (Dubey等人,2024年),Mistral-7B-v0.1(Jiang等人,2023年),Quen2.5-7B(Team,2024b),视觉语言模型PaliGemma2-3B(Beyer等人,2024年). 除了PaliGemma2外,所有模型都是只使用文字的因果变压器,我们包括这个变压器来测试视觉地面是否改变颜色几何. 模型从26层到42层不等,隐藏的维度在2,048到3,584之间.

blocks.en: For each color description, we extract hidden states at all layers (including embeddings, layer 0) and apply mean pooling over token positions to obtain sequence-level representations. We verified that mean and max pooling yield consistent results, while last-token pooling is unstable for causal models (Appendix A ). Unless stated otherwise, all reported metrics use mean pooling and cosine distance in representation space.
blocks.zh: 对于每种颜色描述,我们提取所有层的隐藏状态(包括嵌入,第0层),并应用在符号位置上的平均值集合,以获得序列级的表示. 我们核实了平均和最大集合结果一致,而最后一个集合对于因果模型(附录A)则不稳定。 除非另有说明,所有报告的指标均使用代表空间的集合和余弦距离。

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. Perceptual alignment (P1) is measured via centered kernel alignment (CKA) between model representations and CIE–LAB coordinates. Cross-lingual symmetry (P2) is quantified by congruence: kernel alignment between same-color representations across language pairs. Effective rank captures spectral concentration via normalized entropy of the singular value spectrum. Details in Section 3 .

blocks.en: 5.2 P1: Perceptual Alignment —A Transient Window
blocks.zh: 5.2 P1: 概念对齐——瞬间窗口

blocks.en: Language models perceptually align to CIE–LAB. However, this alignment is transient , i.e., strongest in early-to-intermediate layers and then declining toward the output layer. Figure 2 shows this pattern across various model families and datasets. On MLMC-EN and M-ColorNames , the alignment score peaks between layers 0–6 (depending on model depth), then it drops substantially —by about 80% by the final layer —precisely where representations feed into next-token prediction. Munsell shows higher overall alignment and more persistent structure, though even here some models exhibit mid-layer peaks.
blocks.zh: 语言模型在概念上与CIE-LAB一致. 然而,这种对齐是短暂的,即早期到中间层最强,然后向输出层下降。 图2显示各种示范家庭和数据集的这种模式。 在 MLMC-EN 和 M-ColorNames 上,对齐分数在0–6 层之间达到峰值(取决于模型深度),然后它大幅下降——在最后一层下降约80%——精确地说,表示值会反馈到下层预测中。 Munsell显示整体比对度更高,结构更持久,不过即使在这里,一些模型也显示出中层峰值.

MLMC-EN and M-ColorNames show early-to-mid “perceptual window” with reduced alignment toward final layers. Munsell exhibits higher, more persistent alignment. Uncertainty estimates in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 图 2:观念对齐早高峰,晚崩溃. CKA在模型表示和CIE-LAB之间,每层. 填满的圆圈标记每个模型的峰值. MLMC-EN和M-ColorNames显示早期到中间的“概念窗口”,与最后各层的对齐减少。 Munsell表现出更高的,更持久的对齐。 附录C中的不确定性估计数。

blocks.en: Alignment collapse in deeper layers can be explained by the fact that later layers optimize for language generation, i.e., lexical distinctiveness, contextual regularities, and token-level prediction. This optimization tends to discard some geometric nuance present in earlier layers. While perceptual similarity is useful for intermediate processing, it is not the primary objective of the language-modeling loss and therefore is not preserved at output.
blocks.zh: 更深层的对齐崩溃可以解释为后来的对语言生成的优化,即词典特征,背景规律,以及符号级的预测. 这种优化往往会丢弃一些早期层中存在的几何细微. 虽然知觉相似性对中间处理有用,但它不是语言模型丢失的首要目标,因此在输出时没有保留.

blocks.en:
On Munsell , its behavior could reflect dataset-size bias ( N = 122 N=122 vs. N > 4 000 N>4\,000 ) rather than color geometry.
Therefore, we use matched- n n control to reduce this bias: MLMC-EN subsampled to n = 122 n=122 five times (Table 4 ). Results show that matching reduces the gap ( MLMC final-layer KA increases), but the peak-then-collapse profile persists across all model families. The main difference is thus persistence across depth ( Munsell resists late-layer collapse better) rather than peak strength.
blocks.zh:
在Munsell上,它的行为可以反映数据集大小偏差(N = 122 N = 122 vs. N > 4000 N>4\000),而不是颜色几何.
因此,我们使用匹配-n 控制来减少这种偏差: MLMC-EN 被子样本为n = 122 n = 122 五次(表4 )。 结果显示,配对缩小了差距(MLMC最后一级KA增加),但所有模范家庭的峰值 -- -- 当时的缩合情况仍然存在。 因此,主要的区别是跨深度的持久性(Munsell更能抵御晚期的崩溃),而不是峰值强度.

blocks.en:
Table 4: Matched- n n perceptual control (P1) . MLMC-EN subsamples matched to Munsell size ( n = 122 n=122 ), 5 seeds.
KA is normalized centered CKA to LAB. Matching largely reduces the apparent Munsell advantage while preserving the peak-to-final decay profile across model families.
blocks.zh:
表4: 匹配- n 感知控制(P1). MLMC-EN子样与Munsell大小(n = 122 n = 122),5个种子相匹配.
KA是常态化的CKA中心到LAB. 匹配在很大程度上降低了Munsell的明显优势,同时保留了模范家庭的峰值到最终衰败状况.

blocks.en:
Why does some language preserve perceptual structure better? We find explicit basic color terms (BCTs) systematically enhance alignment. Splitting MLMC-EN by BCT presence reveals that descriptions containing BCTs (e.g., “bright red”) yield 3–4 × \times higher peak alignment than non-BCT descriptions (e.g., “dull teal”), consistent across model families (Table 5 ).
This mechanistic link suggests perceptual grounding emerges primarily when language explicitly evokes canonical categories.
Figurative or indirect naming produces weaker perceptual signatures.
We validate the evaluation pipeline using “LAB-as-representation” unit tests: treating LAB coordinates themselves as representations yields high alignment, while shuffled or random baselines yield near-zero alignment.
blocks.zh:
为什么有些语言会更好地保存知觉结构? 我们发现明确的基本颜色术语系统地加强一致性。 将 MLMC-EN 和 BCT 区分开来表明,含有 BCT 的描述(如 " 赤红色 " ) 的峰值比非 BCT 描述(如 " dull teal " )高3–4 × ,在模型家族之间一致(表5)。
这种机械联系表明,主要在语言明确提到教义类别时才出现概念基础。
显式或间接命名产生较弱的感官签名.
我们通过“LAB-As-Presentation”单元测试来验证评价程序:将LAB本身作为表示值产生高度对齐的处理,而分散或随机的基线则产生接近零的对齐。

blocks.en: We also verify that the near-zero kNN Δ ​ E \Delta E values sometimes observed on Munsell reflect the geometric density of the chip set (small nearest-neighbor LAB distances), rather than an implementation bug. These checks increase confidence that the depth profile in Figure 2 —including the early-to-intermediate peak and reduced final-layer alignment—reflects model geometry rather than metric artifacts.
blocks.zh: 我们还核实,在Munsell上观测到的近0 kNN QQ E\Delta E值有时反映了芯片集的几何密度(最小的近邻LAB距离),而不是一个执行错误. 这些检查增强了对图2中的深度剖面——包括早期到中间峰和减少最终层对齐——反映模型几何而不是度量文物的信心.

blocks.en: Table 5: BCT-conditioned analysis on MLMC-EN . Descriptions containing an explicit basic color term (BCT) exhibit higher perceptual alignment (peak and final CKA) across model families, linking lexical explicitness to more perceptually structured geometry. (Gemma-2-2B rows use a smaller evaluated subset.)
blocks.zh: 表5: MLMC-EN的BCT有条件分析. 包含一个明确的基本颜色术语(BCT)的描述在模型家族中表现出更高的感官比对(峰值和最终的CKA),将词典上的显性与更透视的结构几何联系起来. (Gemma-2-2B行使用一个较小的评价子集. )

blocks.en: 5.3 P2: Cross-Lingual Symmetry —Shared Early, Divergent Late
blocks.zh: 5.3 P2: 跨线对称——共享早,差异晚

blocks.en: Cross-lingual geometry is not universally stable across depth. Instead, we find highest congruence in early layers (embeddings and shallow transformers), with model-dependent degradation as computation proceeds (Figure 3 ). At l = 0 l=0 , congruence across language pairs averages 0.61–0.71 (Table 6 ), indicating substantial shared structure. By final layers, this drops to 0.29–0.56 depending on model family, with Llama/Mistral retaining more symmetry than Gemma/Qwen.
blocks.zh: 跨语言几何在纵深深度上并不普遍稳定. 相反,我们在早期层(嵌入式变压器和浅变压器)中发现最高的一致性,其模型依赖性降解作为计算结果(图3)。 在l = 0 = 0时,各语言对的吻合性平均为 0.61-0.71(表6),表示大量共享结构。 按最终的分层,这依型号家族的不同而下降到0.29–0.56,Llama/Mistral保留了比Gemma/Quen更多的对称性.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Cross-lingual congruence degrades with depth. Mean pairwise CKA between per-language kernels on matched color sets. Thick dashed line: model average; gray band: 95% model-bootstrap CI (robustness to model choice). High early congruence declines in later layers, with model-dependent dynamics.
blocks.zh: 图3:各种语文的一致程度随着深度而下降。 在匹配的颜色集上,每个语言内核之间的平均对称CKA. 粗细的折叠线:模型平均;灰色波段:95%的模型-bootstrap CI(对模型选择的粗糙度). 早期高度一致性在后层下降,具有依赖模型的动态.

blocks.en:
Early layers reflect shared distributional regularities: similar subword tokens, overlapping co-occurrence statistics, and universal lexical structure. Deeper layers increasingly encode language-specific computation: tokenization idiosyncrasies, syntactic templates, and culturally contingent naming patterns. This is not collapse but specialization—later layers transform shared structure into language-conditional representations optimized for their respective linguistic contexts.
The degradation is not universal. Table 6 shows Llama-8B retains 0.56 final-layer congruence, while Gemma-2B drops to 0.30. Some models maintain relatively symmetric late-layer geometry; others exhibit sharp divergence or even mid-layer valleys followed by partial recovery. This heterogeneity suggests symmetry-breaking depends on architectural choices and training dynamics, not just depth alone.
blocks.zh:
早期的层反映了共享的分布规律:相似的子词符,重叠的共聚统计,以及通用的词典结构. 更深层越来越多地编码特定语言的计算:符号化的idiosyncrasies,合成模板,以及文化上的或有命名模式. 这并不是崩溃,而是专业化——后来层层将共享结构转变为适合各自语言背景的有条件语言表述。
退化并不普遍。 表6显示Llama-8B保留了0.56的终层一致,而Gemma-2B则下降到0.30. 一些模型保持相对对称的后层几何;另一些模型表现出尖锐的偏差甚至中层谷地,然后部分恢复. 这种异质性表明对称性的突破取决于建筑选择和培训动态,而不仅仅是深度.

blocks.zh: 表6:跨层语言的一致(对应的套内核).

blocks.en: 5.4 What Enables Geometric Preservation? Spectral Structure
blocks.zh: 5.4 国家 何为几何保存功能 ? 光谱结构

blocks.en: Why do some layers preserve color geometry better than others? We find spectral structure —specifically, effective rank—strongly predicts both perceptual alignment and cross-lingual congruence. Effective rank (ER) measures whether singular values of the representation matrix are spread broadly (high ER, many active dimensions) or concentrated in a few modes (low ER, spectral collapse).
blocks.zh: 为什么有些层保存的颜色几何比其他层更好? 我们发现光谱结构——具体地说,有效的级别——有力地预测了感知的一致和跨语言的一致。 有效的分级(ER)衡量表示矩阵的单值是广义分布(高ER,许多活度维度)还是集中在少数模式(低ER,光谱崩溃).

blocks.en:
Table 7 shows correlations between layer-wise ER and both P1 alignment and P2 congruence. Across datasets and models, correlations are consistently high: r ∈ [ 0.76 , 0.99 ] r\in[0.76,0.99] for most model-dataset pairs. Layers with broad spectral support (high ER) preserve richer relational structure; layers undergoing spectral concentration (low ER) lose both alignment and symmetry.
This provides a unifying explanation for both the perceptual window and cross-lingual degradation. Intermediate layers maintain broad spectra, enabling complex similarity structures. Final layers undergo spectral compression —a form of lossy dimensionality reduction optimizing for next-token prediction. This compression necessarily sacrifices geometric nuance, affecting both perceptual alignment and language-invariant structure. Effective rank thus serves as a practical diagnostic: to find layers that preserve color geometry, seek high ER.
blocks.zh:
表7显示层间ER与P1对齐和P2对齐之间的相互关系。 在整个数据集和模型中,相关性一直很高:r ∈ [0.76, 0.99] r\ in [0.76, 0.99] 对于大多数模型数据集对. 具有广泛光谱支持(高ER)的层保持更丰富的关系结构;正在经历光谱浓度(低ER)的层既失去对齐性,也失去对称性.
这为认知窗口和跨文化退化提供了统一的解释。 中间层保持宽谱,使复杂的相似性结构成为可能. 最后一层进行光谱压缩——一种损耗维度减小的优化形式,用于下层预测. 这种压缩必然会牺牲几何的细微差别,既影响知觉的对齐,也影响语言的变异结构. 因此,有效的排名是一种实用的诊断:找到保存颜色几何的图层,寻求高ER.

blocks.en: 5.5 Functional Consequences: Geometry Predicts Task Performance
blocks.zh: 5.5 功能后果:几何预测任务性能

blocks.en:
Does the geometric structure we measure have functional consequences? Yes. We trained linear probes ( Alain and Bengio, 2016 ) on six color tasks (hue discrimination, warm/cool classification, bright/muted, etc.) at different layers and find that task performance tracks perceptual alignment (see Figure 4 ). Models achieve highest accuracy exactly where P1 alignment peaks, then degrade toward final layers—mirroring the geometric collapse.
On warm/cool classification (testing hue structure), Mistral-7B reached 96.7% accuracy at l = 6 l=6 on MLMC —exactly where perceptual alignment peaks (Figure 5 ). Llama-3.1-8B achieved 95.0% at l = 4 l=4 , Qwen2.5-7B 90.8% at l = 2 l=2 . Performance then degrades toward final layers, mirroring geometric collapse. This pattern generalizes: all six color tasks (color similarity, hue discrimination, brightness, saturation, warm/cool, and bright/muted) peak at layers 2–10, then decline.
blocks.zh:
我们测量的几何结构是否有功能后果? 对 我们培训了线性探测器(Alain和Bengio,2016年),内容涉及不同层的六项颜色任务(区别、温暖/凉爽分类、亮度/混合度等),发现任务性能轨迹的感知比对(见图4)。 模型在P1对齐峰值的精确度最高,然后降解到最后一层——模仿几何崩溃。
在暖/冷分类(测试色素结构)上,Mistral-7B在MLMC上达到96.7%的精度(l=6l=6)——精确到知觉对齐峰(图5)的地方. Llama-3.1-8B在l=4l=4时达到95.0%,在l=2l=2时达到Quen2.5-7B 90.8%. 然后性能向最后层降解,镜像几何崩溃. 这种图案概括了:所有6种颜色任务(颜色相似性,区别性,亮度,饱和度,温暖/凉爽度,以及亮度/摩擦度)在2–10层的峰值,然后下降.

blocks.en: For color-related downstream applications, extract representations from early-to-mid layers (where alignment peaks), not final layers, in line with evidence that intermediate layers can outperform the last layer on general downstream tasks ( Skean et al., 2025 ) . This has immediate practical value: choosing the right layer can yield 2–3 × \times improvement in probe accuracy.
blocks.zh: 对于与颜色相关的下游应用,提取早期到中层(其中对齐峰)的表示,而不是最后层,这符合中间层在一般下游任务上可以超过最后一层的证据(Skean等人,2025年). 这具有即时的实用价值:选择正确的层可以产生2–3×\时间探测精度的提高.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 The Dissociation: Universal Geometry Without Perceptual Grounding
blocks.zh: 6.1 分离:没有概念定位的通用几何

blocks.en: We find that multilingual language models learn color representations that exhibit a striking dissociation: the geometry is partly universal (congruent across languages in early-to-mid layers) but not strongly perceptually grounded (weak alignment to CIE–LAB, transient across depth). This challenges the notion that universal representations in large-scale language models necessarily reflect perceptual or world-grounded structure.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,多语种语言模型学习显示显著脱节的颜色表示:几何部分是通用的(早期到中层的跨语言),但没有强烈的概念基础(与CIE-LAB的微调,跨深度的瞬间)。 这对大规模语言模型中普遍表述必然反映概念或世界结构的观念提出了挑战。

blocks.en: The dissociation is most evident at the output layer, where next-token prediction occurs. Here, cross-lingual symmetry persists at moderate-to-high levels for many models, yet perceptual alignment collapses. This suggests that models learn a color-language geometry optimized for linguistic categorization —supporting lexical distinctions and pragmatic naming—rather than preserving perceptual similarity. The geometry reflects distributional regularities in how languages name colors, not the perceptual organization of color space itself.
blocks.zh: 离散现象在输出层中最为明显,即发生下接的预测. 在这里,多种模型的跨语言对称性在中高水平上持续存在,然而知觉对齐崩溃. 这表明模型学习一种最优化的色彩语言几何学,用于语言分类——支持语法区分和实用命名——而不是保留知觉相似性. 几何在语言如何命名颜色方面反映了分布规律,而不是色彩空间本身的感知组织.

blocks.en: This finding refines recent claims about “platonic representations” in large-scale models. While some domains may converge toward perceptually or physically grounded structure (e.g., object shape, spatial relations), color reveals a domain where convergence occurs along a linguistic axis. The universality we observe is not perceptual universality but distributional universality : patterns shared across languages because of how color terms co-occur with other linguistic elements in text.
blocks.zh: 这一结论改进了最近关于大规模模型中的“柏拉图式表述”的说法。 虽然有些域可能从概念上或实际上趋同(例如物体形状、空间关系),但颜色揭示了一个域,在语言轴上发生趋同。 我们所观察到的普遍性不是概念上的普遍性,而是分布性的普遍性:由于颜色术语如何与其他语言要素在文本中共同存在,所以在语言之间共享的模式。

blocks.en: 6.2 Why Does the Perceptual Window Exist and Collapse?
blocks.zh: 6.2 (中文(简体) ). 为什么概念窗口存在和崩溃?

blocks.en: The transient perceptual window—strongest alignment in early-to-mid layers, collapsing toward the output—suggests a specific computational trajectory. Early layers aggregate subword and lexical information, where color terms co-occur with perceptually correlated contexts (e.g., “sky blue”, “blood red”). This incidental correlation yields moderate perceptual alignment without explicit perceptual supervision.
blocks.zh: 瞬间感知窗口——在早期到中间层中最强的对齐,向输出倾斜——建议具体的计算轨迹。 早期的地层集合了子词和词典信息,其中的颜色术语与感官上下文(如"天空蓝","血红")相配合. 这种偶然的关联在没有明确的认知监督的情况下,产生适度的感知一致性。

blocks.en: As depth increases, representations are transformed toward features directly useful for next-token prediction. Late layers prioritize syntactic, pragmatic, and distributional structure over perceptual similarity. The BCT effect reinforces this: descriptions using basic color terms (e.g., “dark green”) preserve more perceptual structure than figurative or associative descriptions (e.g., “garden’s darkest night”), because BCTs anchor explicit lexical categories that correlate with perceptual regions.
blocks.zh: 随着深度的增加,表示方式被转换为直接用于下一个预测的特征。 后几层将综合、务实和分配结构置于观念相似性之上。 BCT效应强化了这一点:使用基本颜色术语(例如 " 暗绿色 " )的描述比比喻性或关联性描述(例如 " 花园最黑暗的夜晚 " )保存了更多的感知结构,因为BCTs锁定了与感知区域相关的明确词汇类别。

blocks.en: Why does alignment collapse at the output rather than plateau? One explanation is spectral compression : as effective rank drops in late layers, the representational capacity to preserve fine-grained perceptual distinctions degrades. Another is objective mismatch : next-token prediction rewards linguistic coherence and pragmatic plausibility, not perceptual fidelity. Models may actively overwrite perceptual correlates with linguistic structure because the latter is more task-relevant.
blocks.zh: 为什么在产出而不是高原上对齐崩溃? 一种解释是光谱压缩:随着后层的有效排名下降,保留精细感知区分的表达能力下降。 另一个是客观的不匹配:下接的预测奖励了语言的一致性和实用性,而不是观念上的忠诚。 模型可能积极覆盖概念与语言结构的联系,因为后者与任务更为相关。

blocks.en: The matched- N N controls show this is not a sample-size artifact: even when MLMC is downsampled to match Munsell ’s size, the peak-then-collapse profile persists. This indicates the perceptual window reflects model computation, not dataset density.
blocks.zh: N控制显示这并非一个样本大小的文物:即使MLMC被下取样, 这表明知觉窗口反映了模型计算,而不是数据集密度.

blocks.en: 6.3 Why Does Cross-Lingual Symmetry Degrade?
blocks.zh: 6.3 为什么跨语言对称性退化?

blocks.en: Cross-lingual congruence is substantial at embeddings, reflecting shared subword statistics and co-occurrence structure across languages. As depth increases, congruence often declines, with model-dependent trajectories: some architectures retain high symmetry deeper, others show sharper degradation or late-layer recovery.
blocks.zh: 在嵌入时,各语种的一致程度相当高,反映了各语种共用的子词统计和共同使用结构。 随着深度的增加,一致性经常下降,与模型依赖的轨迹:一些建筑保留了较高的对称性更深,另一些则显示出更尖锐的退化或晚期恢复.

blocks.en: This evolution likely reflects a transition from distributional universality in early layers to language-specific functional specialization in late layers. Early layers aggregate evidence from shared multilingual pretraining, where cross-lingual transfer is strong. Deeper layers increasingly encode language-conditional transformations: syntactic ordering, morphological patterns, culturally specific naming conventions, and tokenization idiosyncrasies. The fact that some models retain higher late-layer congruence suggests architectural or objective factors (e.g., parameter sharing, cross-lingual alignment during training) can mitigate this specialization.
blocks.zh: 这种演变可能反映了从早期层次的分布普遍性向后层次语言特有的功能专业化的过渡. 早期地层汇集了来自共享多语种预训的证据,其中跨语种的传承力很强. 更深层越来越多地编码语言-条件转换:合成顺序,形态规律,文化上特有的命名惯例,以及象征式的特异性. 一些模型保留了较高的晚期一致性这一事实表明,建筑或客观因素(如参数共享,培训期间的跨语言校正)可以缓解这种专业化.

blocks.en: Spectral structure again provides a mechanistic link: layers undergoing compression (low effective rank) lose both perceptual alignment and cross-lingual symmetry. This suggests a common underlying mechanism: as representational capacity contracts, models sacrifice fine-grained distinctions—both perceptual and cross-lingual—in favor of coarser linguistic categories optimized for generation.
blocks.zh: 光谱结构再次提供了一种机械联系:层层正在经历压缩(低有效等级),既失去知觉对齐,又失去跨语言对称. 这表明一种共同的基本机制:作为代表能力合同,模型牺牲了精细的区别——既有概念上的区别,也有跨语言的区别——有利于为一代人最优化的粗体语言类别。

blocks.en: 6.4 Implications for Representation Learning
blocks.zh: 6.4 对代表性学习的影响

blocks.en: These findings establish a boundary condition on claims about “platonic” or perceptually grounded representations in large-scale language models. Universal structure can emerge without grounding: models converge on shared color-language geometry not because they learn perceptual similarity, but because they learn shared distributional structure in how languages name colors. This suggests that universality in LMs should be evaluated against multiple reference templates —perceptual, lexical, functional—rather than assumed to reflect world structure by default.
blocks.zh: 这些结论确立了关于大规模语言模型中“柏拉图式”或有概念依据的表述的主张的边界条件。 通用结构可以在不打地基的情况下出现:模型聚集在共享的色彩语言几何上,不是因为他们学习了知觉相似性,而是因为他们学习了如何用语言命名颜色的共享分布结构. 这表明,应参照多种参考模板——概念性、词汇性、功能性——来评价LMs中的普遍性,而不是假设默认地反映世界结构。

blocks.en: The transient perceptual window has practical implications. Tasks requiring perceptual reasoning (e.g., color-based visual QA, accessibility tools) may benefit from probing early-to-mid layers rather than final representations. Conversely, linguistic generation tasks (naming, pragmatic reasoning) align with late-layer representations optimized for next-token prediction. This suggests layer-selective probing strategies should match the task’s demands.
blocks.zh: 瞬间感知窗口具有实际影响. 需要透视推理的任务(例如,基于色彩的视觉QA,无障碍工具)可能从探究早期到中间层而不是最终的表达中得益. 反之,语言生成任务(命名,实用推理)与晚期表现方式一致,优化后期预测. 这说明分层选择的探测策略应该符合任务的要求。

blocks.en: Effective rank provides a simple, interpretable signal for when geometric quality degrades. Layers undergoing spectral compression lose both perceptual alignment and cross-lingual symmetry. This offers a practical tool for model developers: monitoring spectral concentration can flag when representational capacity contracts, potentially guiding interventions (e.g., regularization, architectural choices) to preserve geometric fidelity.
blocks.zh: 有效的排名为几何质量退化时提供了一个简单,可解释的信号. 进行光谱压缩的层既失去知觉对齐,也失去跨语言对称. 这为模型开发者提供了一个实用工具:在代表能力合同时,监测光谱浓度可以标出标志,有可能指导干预措施(如规范化,建筑选择),以保持几何忠诚.

blocks.en: While our focus is text-only models, the dissociation we observe motivates questions for vision-language architectures. Do models with visual grounding exhibit stronger perceptual alignment at the output? Or does the linguistic objective still dominate late layers? Preliminary evidence (e.g., deviations in multimodal models noted in § 5 ) suggests that injecting visual supervision can reweight which factors are preserved, but the extent to which linguistic objectives override perceptual structure remains an open question.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的重点只是文本模型,但我们看到的脱离则激发了视觉语言架构的问题。 具有视觉定位的模型在输出时是否表现出更强的知觉对齐? 还是语言目标仍然主导后层? 初步证据表明(例如,第5节中提到的多式联运模式的偏差),注射视觉监督可以重新权衡哪些因素得到保留,但语言目标在多大程度上超过概念结构仍然是一个未决问题。

blocks.en: 6.5 Limitations and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 6.5 限制和未来方向

blocks.en: Our datasets differ in size and density ( Munsell : n = 122 n=122 chips; MLMC : ∼ \sim 8.5k descriptions; M-ColorNames : ∼ \sim 21k). While matched- N N controls verify that qualitative trends persist under matched evaluation, absolute alignment magnitudes can depend on sampling density. Future work could extend this to systematically sampled color spaces (e.g., CIE–LAB grids) to isolate density effects more precisely.
blocks.zh: 我们的数据集大小和密度不同(Munsell:n=122n=122芯片;MLMC:\sim 8.5k描述;M-ColorNames:\\sim 21k). 虽然N控制可证实在匹配评价下质量趋势持续存在,但绝对吻合度取决于采样密度。 今后的工作可以将这项工作扩大到有系统地取样的颜色空间(例如CIE-LAB网格),以便更准确地隔离密度效应。

blocks.en: We use CKA with RBF kernels as our primary alignment metric. While robust to orthogonal transformations and scaling, absolute values depend on the kernel bandwidth, which we set with the median heuristic; we do not evaluate other bandwidth choices. Alternative similarity metrics (e.g., mutual information, Procrustes distance) could also provide complementary perspectives. Pooling choices also matter: mean/max pooling is stable across models, but last-token pooling shows model-dependent instability (Table 8 ). We recommend content-aggregating pooling for causal LM geometry probes.
blocks.zh: 我们使用以RBF内核为主的CKA作为我们的对齐度量. 绝对值虽然强到正向转换和缩放,但取决于内核带宽,我们用中位heuristic设置;我们不评价其他带宽选择. 替代的相似性衡量标准(例如相互信息、Procrustes距离)也可以提供互补的视角。 集合选择也很重要:平均/最大集合在各模型之间是稳定的,但最后的集合显示模型依赖的不稳定性(表8)。 我们建议对LM几何探测器进行内容汇总。

blocks.en:
Prior work has shown that CKA is not a fully reliable similarity measure: it can
disagree with other measures, and it can change under transformations that leave
a model’s behavior unchanged ( Ding et al., 2021 ; Davari et al., 2023 ) .
These studies compare neural networks with each other, whereas we compare a network to a fixed perceptual reference (CIE–LAB), so we do not claim that their findings carry over directly. To limit our reliance on any single measure, we also report Spearman correlation, matched- N N controls, and sanity-check baselines, and we relate alignment to probe accuracy. We interpret CKA values as relative comparisons across layers, not as absolute measures of perceptual
grounding.

着陆

blocks.en: Color is a controlled, well-studied domain with established perceptual metrics. Whether the dissociation we observe generalizes to other perceptual domains (e.g., shape, spatial relations, auditory concepts) remains open. Some domains may show stronger perceptual grounding (e.g., spatial prepositions), others may exhibit similar distributional convergence. Systematic cross-domain studies would clarify when and why LMs preserve perceptual structure.
blocks.zh: 色彩是一个受控,研究良好的领域,有既定的知觉度量. 我们观测到的离散是否概括到其他感知域(如形状,空间关系,听觉概念)仍然开放. 有些领域可能显示更强的知觉定位(如空间预设),另一些领域可能显示类似的分布式趋同. 系统性的跨领域研究将澄清LMs何时和为什么保留知觉结构。

blocks.en: We identify where (early-to-mid layers) and when (spectral compression) geometry degrades, but not precisely how . Future work using causal intervention methods (e.g., activation patching, ablations) could trace which computations overwrite perceptual structure and which preserve cross-lingual symmetry. This would move from correlation to causation, clarifying the mechanisms underlying the dissociation.
blocks.zh: 我们确定(早期到中层)和(光谱压缩)几何降解的时间,但不确切地说是如何降解的。 未来使用因果干预方法(如激活补丁,拼贴)的工作可以追踪哪些方法可以计算透视概念结构,哪些方法可以保留跨语言对称性. 这将从相关性转向因果关系,澄清分离背后的机制。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Multilingual language models learn color representations that are partly universal but not perceptually grounded. The geometry reflects distributional regularities in how languages name colors, not the perceptual organization of color space. This dissociation is clearest at the output layer, where next-token prediction occurs: cross-lingual symmetry persists, but perceptual alignment collapses. A transient perceptual window exists in early-to-mid layers, but late layers prioritize linguistic structure over perceptual fidelity. Spectral compression explains when geometry degrades: layers with low effective rank lose both alignment and symmetry. Functionally, geometric quality predicts task performance, with practical implications for layer selection and probing strategies. These findings challenge the notion that scale and multilingual training automatically yield perceptually grounded representations, suggesting instead that universality in LMs reflects shared linguistic structure, not necessarily world structure.
blocks.zh: 多语种语言模型学习部分通用但并非有概念基础的色彩表现. 几何学在语言如何命名颜色方面反映了分布规律,而不是色彩空间的感知组织. 这种离散在输出层最明显,即发生下个托肯预测的地方:跨语言对称持续,但知觉对齐崩溃. 早期至中层存在瞬间感知窗口,但后层优先使用语言结构而不是知觉忠贞. 光谱压缩解释几何降解时:低有效阶次的层会同时失去对齐性和对称性. 功能上,几何质量预测任务性能,对层层选择和探测策略有实际影响. 这些结论对规模和多语种培训自动产生有概念依据的表述的概念提出了质疑,相反,这些结论表明,LMs中的普遍性反映了共同的语言结构,不一定反映世界结构。

blocks.en: To characterize the linguistic content of color descriptions across languages, we analyze the usage of Basic Color Terms (BCTs) following Berlin and Kay [1991] . BCTs are psychologically salient, monolexemic color words that are widely used and relatively stable across speakers (e.g., “red”, “blue”, “green”).
blocks.zh: 为了描述不同语言的色彩描述的语言内容,我们分析了柏林和凯之后的基本色彩术语(BCT)的使用[1991]. BCT在心理上是突出的,单色的彩色词,广泛使用,在扬声器上相对稳定(如"红","蓝色","绿色").

blocks.en: For each language, we construct a BCT dictionary covering the 11 canonical categories (white, black, red, green, yellow, blue, brown, purple, pink, orange, gray). For two languages we incorporate linguistically motivated extensions:

blocks.en: Korean (31 terms). Modern Korean exhibits multiple co-existing color-naming strata, including (i) native Korean forms, (ii) adjective forms, (iii) Sino-Korean terms, and (iv) loanwords; these correlate with register (informal/formal/technical/trendy) and are all productive in contemporary usage [ Sohn, 2001 , Lee and Ramsey, 2001 ] . We include representative terms from all strata, e.g., native/adjectival 빨강/빨간(“red”), Sino-Korean 적색(“red”), and loanword 레드(“red”).
blocks.zh: 韩文(31个学期). 现代韩国展出多种共同存在的颜色命名层,包括(一) 韩国本土形式,(二) 形容词形式,(三) 中韩术语,(四) 借词;这些与注册(非正式/正式/技术/专利)相关,在当代使用中都是有成效的[Sohn,2001年,Lee和Ramsey,2001年]。 我们包括来自各个阶层的代表性术语,例如:原生/形容语 빨강/빨간("红色"),中韩语 ("红色")和借词 레드("红色").

blocks.en: Russian (12 terms). Russian distinguishes siniy (dark blue) and goluboi (light blue), a categorical split absent in many other languages. Prior work shows categorical perception effects at the siniy–goluboi boundary comparable to cross-category boundaries elsewhere, suggesting both are psychologically basic [ Winawer et al., 2007 ] . We therefore include both in the Russian dictionary.
blocks.zh: 俄语(12个任期). 俄语区分siniy(暗蓝色)和goluboi(浅蓝色),这是许多其他语言中不存在的绝对分裂. 先前的研究表明,在Siniy-Goluboi边界上与其他地方的跨类别边界相当的绝对感知效应,表明两者都是心理基础[Winawer等人,2007年]。 因此,我们把两者都列入俄罗斯词典。

blocks.en: We mark a description as containing a BCT if it includes any dictionary term under case-folding. blocks.en: We evaluate three pooling strategies for causal LMs (max, mean, last-token) on MLMC-EN ( N ≤ 1000 N\leq 1000 ). As shown in Table 8 , mean and max pooling yield broadly similar peak locations and peak-to-final decay across all tested families, indicating that the main P1 pattern is not sensitive to this choice of content-aggregating pooling. In contrast, last-token pooling is unstable and model-dependent: it collapses alignment for Gemma and Mistral, but can yield higher peaks for Llama and Qwen. This suggests that sequence-end representations can be disproportionately shaped by token-position or prompt-format effects, making last-token pooling a poor default for geometry probes of causal LMs. We therefore use mean/max pooling as the default and treat last-token pooling as a non-robust ablation.
